intro: Persian culture is famous for poetry, carpets, gardens and architecture that influenced much of Asia.

chapters.title: Poetry
text: Ferdowsi's Shahnameh, the 'Book of Kings', tells Iran's legendary history in about 50,000 couplets. Iranians quote Hafez and Saadi in daily life, and many homes keep a book of Hafez's poems.

chapters.title: Arts
text: Persian carpets are prized around the world. Blue-tiled mosques in Isfahan and walled Persian gardens are on UNESCO's list. Iranian cinema, from Abbas Kiarostami to Asghar Farhadi, has won top international prizes.

chapters.title: Nowruz
text: Nowruz, the Persian New Year at the spring equinox, is the biggest celebration, with a table of seven symbolic items starting with the letter 's'.
